# google_oracle_database_autonomous_database_wallet

Generates a client credentials wallet for an Autonomous Database and provides
access to its contents.


To get more information about AutonomousDatabaseWallet, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/oracle/database/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.autonomousDatabases/generateWallet)
* How-to Guides
    * [Create Autonomous databases](https://cloud.google.com/oracle/database/docs/create-databases)

~> **Warning:** The generated wallet is stored in plain text in the Terraform state. Destroying this
resource only removes it from the Terraform state; it doesn't revoke the wallet. This
API has no method to revoke or rotate wallets; rotating the wallet in Oracle Cloud
Infrastructure invalidates it. Per Oracle, generating a wallet doesn't invalidate
wallets generated earlier. To get a new wallet (for example, before the wallet's
certificates expire), replace this resource.

~> **Warning:** All arguments including the following potentially sensitive
values will be stored in the raw state as plain text: `password`, `archive_content`.
[Read more about sensitive data in state](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/manage-sensitive-data).

~> **Note:**  All arguments marked as write-only values will not be stored in the state: `password_wo`.
[Read more about Write-only Arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/write-only-arguments).

## Example Usage - Oracledatabase Autonomous Database Wallet Basic


```hcl
resource "google_oracle_database_autonomous_database" "myADB" {
  autonomous_database_id = "my-instance"
  location               = "us-east4"
  project                = "my-project"
  database               = "mydatabase"
  admin_password         = "123Abpassword"
  network                = data.google_compute_network.default.id
  cidr                   = "10.5.0.0/24"
  properties {
    compute_count        = "2"
    data_storage_size_tb = "1"
    db_version           = "19c"
    db_workload          = "OLTP"
    license_type         = "LICENSE_INCLUDED"
  }

  deletion_protection = "true"
}

data "google_compute_network" "default" {
  name    = "new"
  project = "my-project"
}

resource "google_oracle_database_autonomous_database_wallet" "myWallet" {
  autonomous_database = google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.myADB.id
  password_wo         = "123Abpassword"
  password_wo_version = 1
}

# A second wallet for the same database, using the non-write-only password argument.
resource "google_oracle_database_autonomous_database_wallet" "wallet_password" {
  autonomous_database = google_oracle_database_autonomous_database.myADB.id
  type                = "SINGLE"
  password            = "123Abpassword"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `autonomous_database` -
  (Required)
  The name of the Autonomous Database to generate the wallet for, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/autonomousDatabases/{autonomous_database}`.


* `type` -
  (Optional)
  The type of wallet to generate. `SINGLE` generates an instance wallet for this
  database only.
  Default value is `SINGLE`.
  Possible values are: `SINGLE`.

* `password` -
  (Optional)
  The password used to encrypt the keys inside the wallet. It must be at least
  8 characters long. It protects only the password-protected wallet files (such as
  `ewallet.p12`); the auto-login `cwallet.sso` file in the wallet doesn't need it.
  **Note**: This property is sensitive and will not be displayed in the plan.

* `password_wo` -
  (Optional, Write-Only)
  The password used to encrypt the keys inside the wallet. It must be at least
  8 characters long. It protects only the password-protected wallet files (such as
  `ewallet.p12`); the auto-login `cwallet.sso` file in the wallet doesn't need it.
  **Note**: This property is write-only and will not be read from the API.

  ~> **Note:** One of `password` or `password_wo` can only be set.

* `password_wo_version` -
  (Optional)
  Triggers update of `password_wo` write-only. Increment this value when an update to `password_wo` is needed. For more info see [updating write-only arguments](/docs/providers/google/guides/using_write_only_arguments.html#updating-write-only-arguments)

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{autonomous_database}}/wallet`

* `archive_content` -
  The base64-encoded contents of the wallet ZIP archive.
  **Note**: This property is sensitive and will not be displayed in the plan.

This resource provides the following
